product_metadata.title: My OLi 36" Under Door Draft Stopper Heavy Duty Door Draft Blocker Noise Dust Wind Stop Soundproof Energy Saver for Indoor Home,Blue
features: Under door draft stopper: Heavy duty stopper is filled with PP cotton with sands bags to confirm its stability, can be tightly attached to the door. L 36 inch*W 6 inch*H 3 inch.

Multi-Function: Can reduce the noise and block the cold/hot wind/smoke outside, keep your room warmer in winter, cooler in summer. Even can block snake. Not only save energy but also lower your electricity bill. Help you saves on energy costs year round.
Easy to use: Heavy duty Door draft blocker can be move with the doors whether you open or close. This door stopper is suitable for all floor types. And will not cause damage to your door.
Design Structure: My OLi door gap blocker have classic colors and elegant appearance, especially using hanging loop, you can hang it anywhere when not using, such as door handles, closet hooks, etc.

Quality Service: 24 hours online customer service, if you have any questions about the products, just inform us by Amazon message, we will always be here to help you and do our best to make you happy.
